michot2008.title: Caractéristiques thermophysiques de matériaux à base d'argile : évolution avec des traitements thermiques jusqu'à 1400°C
michot2008.author: Aurélie Michot
michot2008.formula_unit: J kg^-1 K^-1; temperature in K

raw_kaolin_equation4_1.status: handbook relation printed in thesis, not a new project fit

calcined_equation4_2.status: oxide mixture rule printed in thesis; no formation energy or absolute entropy

calorimetry.high_temperature_measurements: 350-1100 C on specimens pretreated at 1050 or 1400 C; Figure 4-10 caption says 350-1200 C
calorimetry.high_temperature_repeatability: thesis Table 4-2 reports maximum deviations 1.3/3.5/7.4% for solid repeats, 4% mixed, 23% powder; these are comparisons to mixture calculation, not universal confidence intervals

michot2008.pretreatment: 5 C/min to 500/600/700 C; 500/600 C powders air-quenched; 700 C held for one hour
michot2008.phase_state_limit: Same sensible Cp approximation after different prior firing temperatures does not define reaction heat during changing mineral phases.
open_source_questions: Figure 4-10 appears lower than printed Equation 4-2 at high temperature; requires quantitative chart review.
Oxide Cp phase identities and original handbook temperature ranges have not been verified from that handbook.
2011 journal abstract gives a different post-dehydroxylation expression; no formal correction or full journal article obtained.
